verdict.rationale: Medusa's documented MCP server (medusa-docs-4, medusa-docs-33, medusa-probe-3, medusa-probe-rt-1) is explicitly a documentation-search server for AI coding tools like Cursor, not a store-facing agent-commerce endpoint for product discovery or cart-building. The evidence shows a traditional Store REST/OpenAPI spec (medusa-gh-x1) but no MCP/UCP-style agent-commerce protocol exposed on the storefront itself.
